subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------SPT.GH.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-11. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'To understand the reality position of black creativity is to view the significance of "extended functionalism" — which is to say, any attempt to accurately comment on the music must imply some real understanding of the "reality of extended functionalism."' The crossing diagrams how alternative-functionalism structurally meets spiritual-growth at the extended-functionalism scale: ALT-FT (alternative functionalism — the actual working alternative-functioning of black-creative music) crossed with SPT-GH (spiritual growth). ALT-FT sits at the bottom-center with the subject-arrow; INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) above the subject and TRS (transition) centrally as the bridging hub. SPT-GH sits at upper-left as partner-axis; MOT-DY (motion dynamics) hangs below SPT-GH on the left margin and ATTN (attraction) anchors the lower-left as the partner-side downward chain. POL-DY (political dynamics) at top-center and SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) at top-right with LG-EXT (logical extension) and PART (participation) and INFO-DY (information dynamics) anchoring the right margin as the partner-side upper-and-right chain. PER-DY (perception dynamics) sits centrally with AF-NT (affinity nature) below as the bridging-side outputs. Structural argument: when alternative-functionalism is crossed with spiritual-growth, the upper diagonal TRS → POL-DY → SOC-RT-DY → LG-EXT → PART → INFO-DY is the *extended-functionalism reception route* — transition routes through political-dynamics into social-reality dynamics, then through logical-extension into participation and finally into information-dynamics. This is the partner-axis route through which the form's working actually reaches the receiving culture's information-channel. The SPT-GH → MOT-DY → ATTN chain on the left is what spiritual-growth produces alone — motion-dynamics into attraction, the vibrational residual without the form's working content. INDIV-TD → TRS bridges the subject up into the central hub; TRS → PER-DY → AF-NT routes transition through perception-dynamics into affinity-nature. The 'reality of extended functionalism' the prose names is structurally the upper-diagonal *and* the central TRS hub both holding — without both, alternative-functionalism produces only the spiritual-growth left-chain on the partner-side, while the form's actual extended-functionalism reaches participation only through the long right-chain that the receiving culture supplies on its own terms.
